required_evidence: Direct evidence of non-transportable or spurious IDS predictors and methodological evidence distinguishing predictive sensitivity from causal identification; support for controls/placebos if available
what_the_reference_must_NOT_be_used_to_c: That the specific features in this project are proven leakage; that shortcuts cause all cross-dataset failure; that any ablation improvement identifies a causal mechanism
